adversarial_claim: Verified feedback does not count, or an agent's self-feedback counts positively, or feedback needs no evidence.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Verified feedback': FEEDBACK reported by an evaluator, SUCCESS, task_quality; it cites the completed assessment it conveys and counts as an assessment does (14.2; 14.6 rules 5 to 9). One positive unit (15.3).

Draft 14.5, row 'Verified feedback', from the agent itself as a diagnostic (14.2): it needs no record, and a success has zero weight (14.6 rule 11; 14.3: self-declared confidence earns no positive reputation). It is not listed (15.2).

Draft 14.5, row 'Verified feedback': from an evaluator it cites the completed assessment it conveys; this report cites none (14.2: tied to an observed task), so a positive unit would rest on the signer's word alone.
